content: {"reasoning":"The two adjudications returned CO-97 (bundled, a Contractual Obligation), and we have already tried correcting/resubmitting and filing a medical-necessity appeal. Auth is irrelevant here since this CPT needs no prior auth and no retro window exists. With no payer response currently on the table, appeal and peer-to-peer are unavailable, and a resubmission would trigger a CO-18 duplicate denial. Because CO-97 is a contractual adjustment, the balance cannot be billed to the patient and must be closed out.","action":"write_off"}
